hypotheses.justification: `rhoC t` is nonnegative for every real `t`. In the first branch it is `1/2`; in the last it is `0`. In the middle branches, the failed earlier conditions imply `t > params.phi`, so `0 ≤ t` follows from `Romik.phi_pos_of_mem_box params_mem` and `phi_nonneg`. The existing phase-2 and phase-3 nonnegativity lemmas then apply. In phase 4, the failed `t ≤ eta` condition gives `eta ≤ t`, and the branch condition supplies `t ≤ tau`, so `rhoC_phase4_nonneg` applies. Thus the proof can split on the same conditions without using `ht`; no out-of-range real values create an exception.
